title: IEEE BUC Student Branch Officially Launched
excerpt: The IT Department at Al Buraimi University College organized the inauguration of the IEEE BUC Student Branch.
content: The IT Department at Al Buraimi University College organized the inauguration of the IEEE BUC Student Branch, showcasing the college’s dedication to technical innovation and enhancing the student research environment. The event was honored by the presence of Dr. Yahya Al Balushi, Vice Chair of the IEEE Oman Section, who delivered an insightful lecture on the role of IEEE in empowering students professionally and academically.

title: New Workshop Series Announced
excerpt: IEEE BUC is excited to announce a new series of technical workshops for the spring semester.
content: We're launching a comprehensive workshop series covering Arduino, Python, Web Development, and more. Stay tuned for registration details!

title: IEEE BUC Wins Regional Award
excerpt: Our student branch was recognized as the Most Active Branch in the IEEE Oman Section.
content: We're proud to announce that IEEE BUC has been awarded the Most Active Student Branch award at the IEEE Oman Section Annual Meeting.
